purpose: Automatic context window per simulated tier with speculative decoding off, so the choice does not depend on local weights. The draft-head tiers are gated in Tools/planner_gates.sh with a placeholder head.
schema_note: Version 2 changes only tier 48. Without the draft head the decode lookahead now runs in plain decode and reserves 373 MiB, which moves that tier's 32,768-token cache from 152 to 149 experts per layer, inside the measured decode range of 150. The rule therefore prices the 131,072-token window, 130 experts per layer at +5.9% to the typical request, instead of declining it as an unmeasured cache reduction. Each tier also plans with --model at an absent directory so the lookahead's charge never depends on an installed tap-correction file. Version 1 stays as the historical fixture.
